title: TRIDENT: A Redundant Architecture for Caribbean-Accented Emergency Speech Triage

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) performance disparities and transcription confidence drops on non-standard English varieties, specifically focusing on Caribbean-accented speech and stress-induced shifts toward basilectal (creole) registers.

Analyzing the impact of sexually dimorphic fundamental frequency (F0) baselines in bio-acoustic distress detection, and mitigating disparities between male and female speakers by employing sex-adaptive parameters and prioritizing sex-normalized acoustic features.
